question: Let $A,B,C$ and $D$ be finite sets such that $|A|<|C|$ and $|B|=|D|$, where $|A|$ stands for the number of elements in the set $A$. Then

options.B: $|A\cup B|\le |C\cup D|$ but $|A\cup B|<|C\cup D|$ need not always be true
options.C: $|A\cup B|<2|C\cup D|$ but $|A\cup B|\le |C\cup D|$ need not always be true
options.D: none of the foregoing statements is true

source.title: Test of Mathematics at the 10+2 Level — Sixteenth Edition
